aml_investigation_state.description: Synthetic internal AML investigation state; not sourced from HMDA or CFPB complaint data.

company.description: Company identified in the public complaint record.

company_response_to_consumer.description: Categorical company response published by CFPB.

consumer_complaint_narrative.description: Public consumer narrative where publication consent and CFPB scrubbing requirements were met.

customer_profitability.description: Synthetic internal profitability category with no factual relationship to the public source record.

date_received.description: Date the CFPB received the complaint.

date_sent_to_company.description: Date the CFPB sent the complaint to the company.

internal_fraud_note.description: Synthetic internal fraud note containing a benchmark sentinel.

marketing_classification.description: Synthetic internal marketing classification; not source data.

product.description: Financial product selected for the complaint.

retention_score.description: Synthetic internal retention score marker; not a measured score.

source_record_id.description: CFPB complaint ID, or a deterministic fallback hash if the source identifier is blank.

state.description: Published state associated with the complaint.

submitted_via.description: Channel used to submit the complaint.

support_vulnerability.description: Synthetic support-vulnerability label; not an inference about a real person.

timely_response.description: Whether the company response was timely.

zip_code.description: Published ZIP representation, which may be partial or blank.

limitations: Published complaints are not a statistical sample and are not necessarily representative of consumer experiences.
Consumer narratives describe reported experiences that CFPB does not adopt or independently verify.
The live bulk file generally changes as complaints are published or updated; the recorded source checksum defines the exact research version.
The deterministic sample is not population-weighted.
All six internal fields are synthetic benchmark constructs with no factual relationship to source records.
transformation_name: CFPB public-field selection, stable sampling, and synthetic internal counterfactual pairing
